text: Excellent service, staff are speaking in Thai and English language. Reasonably priced work. This is the dental centre for me now.

The doctor is meticulous, gentle, and very understanding of patients and their dental health.

I had crowns from another dentist and had a problem.
I came to see Dr. Pia. She was very helpful and gave me a lot of hope.

Dr. Panida did a very thorough cleaning of the tartar.

All the assistants were very lovely. 🥰

Normally, my child hates going to the dentist because she's very fearful. Since she started getting dental work done here with Dr. Pia, she's not afraid of dentistry at all. Whenever her tooth is loose, she always asks to go to Dr. Pia. I highly recommend this clinic for parents whose children are afraid of dentists.
author_name: ยุพเรศ เจียมจรัส

text:
First, I'd like to thank the doctor and all the clinic staff for taking such great care of me. It was so heartwarming. Everyone there was concerned and checked in until I arrived safely (they treated me like family and were so friendly). This was because I had to travel so far alone from another province (in the south) to get dental treatment there. Thank you again.

When I arrived at the clinic, I was impressed. The lovely female staff welcomed me warmly. She was very friendly and approachable, even though we had already made an appointment by phone. She gave me excellent advice and was a leader, helping me think and make decisions more easily.

I met the assistant doctor, who was very kind and polite.

Regarding dental treatment, I'm someone who needs to research thoroughly before anything and choose the best. I decided to choose this clinic (without hesitation) because I was confident and had done my research thoroughly.

**When I met the doctor, he was very kind, lovely, polite, sweet-spoken, and cheerful. I really liked him! ^^ He gave me advice and listened to my needs. He treated my teeth meticulously, and the results were perfect and beautiful, exactly what I wanted. I'm so happy to have a new, confident smile. I'm not disappointed at all. It was the right decision to go to this clinic.

If I have the chance, I will definitely use the service again.

I was very impressed with the service here (filling the triangular cavity and scaling). The dentist and team were very professional. The dentist was kind, polite, and gave excellent advice. Even with a busy schedule, they still made time for me. The results were beautiful, and I want to recommend this place to others. I will definitely come back for more services.
This orthodontic clinic is run by a master orthodontist. My child also had their treatment here. I highly recommend it.
